text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Four Bahrainis confess to their roles in arson attacks in a Bahraini village last September in which an Asian worker died and two others were injured.
- State Security Court jails 11 Bahrainis found guilty of arson attacks on private and public property.
- First Russian technology exhibition in Bahrain will be held in December.
- Labour and Social Affairs Ministry takes new measures to organise labour market.

- Gulf Arab states' four-member mediation committee goes to Qatar on Sunday before visiting Bahrain. The committee was formed to try to improve relations between Bahrain and Qatar, locked in a territorial dispute.
